content: File selection: Native mobile (Capacitor) use @capawesome/capacitor-file-picker pickFiles() - returns metadata + path on Android/iOS (read via fetch() as blob), Blob on web; NEVER readData:true for large files (base64 OOM crash - official Capawesome warning); no runtime permissions needed (system picker presents itself); types filter accepted. Desktop web: <input type=file accept='.std,.txt'> is the universal baseline (works in all browsers + WebViews); showOpenFilePicker is a Chromium-only progressive enhancement; drag-and-drop with native HTML5 onDrop (no drag library) with a full-window drop overlay is the desktop-expected pattern. iOS Files-app integration needs UIFileSharingEnabled + LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace in Info.plist. First-call Safari picker bug fixed in file-picker v5.1.1+ (PR #111).
